findings.current: At that moment, the people before me didn’t look like the heads of factions shouldering immense responsibility and thousands of lives.
findings.defect: The draft changes the scale of the lives at stake from tens of thousands to thousands.
findings.rationale: The source says 수만 명 in the immediately following image of the same leaders and their responsibility.
findings.replacement: At that moment, the people before me didn’t look like the heads of factions shouldering immense responsibility and tens of thousands of lives.
findings.source: 막중한 책임과 목숨을 짊어진 일파의 영수(領袖)들이 아니라

findings.current: He glanced at Sima Gong, who remained silently still, like a loyal dog checking its master’s mood.
findings.defect: The English makes Sima Gong the loyal dog. The comparison describes Sect Leader Seok as he checks Sima Gong’s mood.
findings.rationale: Seok is the one glancing at Sima Gong; the simile characterizes Seok’s deference.
findings.replacement: Like a loyal dog checking his master’s mood, he stole a glance at the silent Sima Gong.
findings.source: 마치 주인의 기분을 살피는 충견처럼, 조용히 침묵을 지키고 있는 사마공을 힐끗 바라보며.

findings.current: “Great Hero Jin, I respect the sense of justice you’ve shown us until now, but surely there are certain principles we must uphold.”
findings.defect: The speaker’s mid-address correction to a more respectful title disappears.
findings.rationale: 진 소, 아니 대협 visibly revises the form of address, exposing the speaker’s attention to Taekyung’s standing.
findings.replacement: “Young Hero Jin—no, Great Hero Jin—I respect the sense of justice you’ve shown us until now, but surely there are certain principles we must uphold.”
findings.source: “진 소, 아니 대협께서 지금껏 보여 주신 의협심에 대해서는 경의를 표하지만, 그래도 지켜야 할 도리라는 것이 있지 않겠소이까?”

findings.current: Do you think the marquis personally appointed by His Majesty the Emperor himself is worth jack shit?
findings.defect: Taekyung’s pointed correction from “Son of Heaven” to the more deferential “His Majesty the Emperor” is omitted.
findings.rationale: The self-correction is part of his mock-formal invocation of imperial authority, set against the crude punchline.
findings.replacement: Does a marquis appointed by the Son of Heaven—no, by His August Majesty the Emperor himself—look like jack shit to you?
findings.source: 천자, 아니 지엄하신 황제 폐하께서 친히 임명하신 열후가 개좆으로 보여요?

findings.current: In a world where the two sides treated each other like a cow looking at a chicken, it was obvious that flaunting one side’s authority would only breed resentment.
findings.defect: The literal animal image does not naturally convey mutual indifference in English.
findings.rationale: 소 닭 보듯 means regarding someone with indifference; the image itself is not needed to preserve the point.
findings.replacement: In a world where the two sides barely spared each other a glance, it was obvious that flaunting either side’s authority would only breed resentment.
findings.source: 서로를 소 닭 보듯 하는 이 바닥에서 괜히 어느 한쪽의 권위를 내세워 봤자 반감을 사리라는 것은 자명한 사실.

findings.current: That’s right. It’s all for the prosperity of our family and the Black Dragon Demon Gate.
findings.defect: “Prosperity” loses the sense of restoring or reviving their fortunes.
findings.rationale: 부흥 denotes revival or resurgence rather than prosperity alone.
findings.replacement: That’s right. It’s all for the resurgence of our family and the Black Dragon Demon Gate.
findings.source: 그래, 맞다. 전부 우리 일가(一家)와 흑룡마문의 부흥을 위한 것이다.

summary: Two scene facts are altered, and several meaningful register and wording cues are lost.
